verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Incident Workflows are a first-party engine with configurable triggers and actions. They apply "if-this-then-that" logic and can fire automatically on incident conditions such as P1/P2 priority, which covers the core of the story. The specific toil actions the story names (status updates, reminders, field changes) are not documented in the evidence; only webhook POSTs, scheduling a Scribe Agent and auto-pausing notifications appear as actions. Missing for 10: documented actions for incident status updates, reminders, and field/property changes, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow engine.

support.subject: As an SRE, a condition-based workflow engine automates the toil — updates, reminders, field changes — triggered by incident events

citations.quote: Through highly-configurable triggers and actions, you can apply "if-this-then-that" logic to orchestrate the right response for your teams, processes, and business.
For example, you can configure one workflow that automatically triggers for all P1 and P2 incidents
Send a POST request with a customized body and headers.
Schedule a Scribe Agent to join incident calls and record key decisions, action items, and events once a conference bridge is available.
